theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_wll_residue_composition_series
theorems.statement: ∀ (A B : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Algebra A B] (b : B), b ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, Module.length A (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({b} : Set B)) = (n : ℕ∞) → ∃ s : CompositionSeries (Submodule B (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({b} : Set B))), s.head = ⊥ ∧ s.last = ⊤ ∧ ∃ p : Fin s.length → IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum B, ∀ i : Fin s.length, Nonempty ((↥(s i.succ) ⧸ (s i.castSucc).comap (s i.succ).subtype) ≃ₗ[B] (B ⧸ (p i).asIdeal))
theorems.natural_summary: Finite A-length implies the quotient is Noetherian and Artinian over B, yielding a composition series from zero to the whole module. Each covering quotient is simple and therefore isomorphic to B modulo a maximal ideal. The nonzero element b annihilates every factor, so each such ideal contains b and is nonzero, defining a height-one prime. Choosing these primes gives the required labeling and isomorphisms.
